Eight days, 10 to 18 May 2025, Edinburgh to Inverness the long way round, with Dani. Rain on six of the eight days,
sun exactly when we needed it.

## The car

Kia Ceed from Thistle Drive Hire at Edinburgh airport, booking TDH-88214, £312 for the eight days plus £9 a day
excess cover. Manual gearbox, driving on the left, I stalled it twice leaving the car park. The
[[Road trip car checklist]] saved us: the spare tyre was flat at pickup and they swapped it.

## Edinburgh to Glencoe

Three hours via Stirling. Glencoe visitor centre parking £5. Short walk up to the Lost Valley, 4 hours return, much
steeper than the sign implied. Stayed at the Clachan Mòr bunkhouse, £38 each.

## Skye

Crossed the Skye Bridge on day 3. Camped two nights at Torvaig Croft campsite, just outside Portree: £24 a night for
a tent pitch and two adults, hot showers included, the owner Morag gave us fresh eggs. The Old Man of Storr at 7am
before the coaches, Fairy Pools in drizzle, Neist Point lighthouse in wind so strong I could lean on it.

## Bealach na Bà

The pass to Applecross climbs to 626 m with hairpins like a cartoon. Single-track with passing places: pull in left,
let faster traffic by, wave at everyone. At the Applecross Inn I had langoustines for £26 and would do the pass
again just for those.

## Midges

They are real. Smidge spray, £8.50 from the Portree pharmacy, worked about 70% of the time. Head nets for the
campsite evenings, £4 each.

## Fuel and costs

Diesel about £1.52 a litre, fuel stations get sparse on the west coast so we filled up whenever below half. Total
fuel £148. Whole trip about £640 each including the car.

## Comparing notes

Same feeling as the [[Iceland ring road]]: waterfalls round every bend, guesthouses that close at 9pm, long light
evenings. But Scotland has pubs, which changes everything.

## Accents

Morag's Skye accent I understood fine, a guy in a Glasgow service station I did not catch a single word from. Made
me think about my own accent work in [[Accent reduction]].
